units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 11:5">Targ. Num. XI, 5</cite> ed. Berl. <he>כָּ׳</he> (oth. ed. <he>כְּ׳</he>; Yarg. Y. II <cite ref="K01287"><he>כְּרָתַיָּא</he></cite>, some ed. <cite ref="K01287"><he>כְּרַתְיָא</he></cite>; h. text <cite ref="H01529"><he>חָצִיר</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b:2">Ab. Zar. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>שדר ליה כ׳</he> he (the emperor) sent him leek (symbolically alluding to <he>כרת</he>, ‘my progeny will be cut off’, Rashi).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 4:6:5">Y. Kil. IV, end, 29ᶜ</cite> <he>זרע כרמיה כרתין</he> planted leek in his vineyard.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:23">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> <he>ההן דגזז … כ׳ וכ׳</he> he who cuts (on the Sabbath) coriander …, leek &c. Bab.
